# freshdesk_canned_response (Resource)

A reusable reply template agents can insert into a ticket.

~> The Freshdesk API offers no way to delete a canned response. Destroying this resource removes it from state and warns; the response itself stays until it is deleted in the portal.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_html` (String) Body of the response, in HTML.

~> Freshdesk rewrites the markup it is given, so this attribute keeps what you configured and `content` exposes the stored rendering. A body edited in the portal cannot be detected as drift.
- `folder_id` (Number) ID of the folder holding the response.
- `title` (String) Title of the response, shown in the agent's picker.

### Optional

- `group_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the groups that may use the response. Only used when `visibility` is `2`.
- `visibility` (Number) Who may use the response: `0` all agents, `1` only the owner, `2` selected groups.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Plain-text rendering of the response as Freshdesk stores it.
- `created_at` (String) When the canned response was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the canned response.
- `updated_at` (String) When the canned response was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_canned_response.example 42
```
